import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
alabama_rate = df[(df['State'] == 'Alabama') & (df['Year'] == 2012)]['Age-adjusted Rate'].iloc[0]
alaska_rate = df[(df['State'] == 'Alaska') & (df['Year'] == 2012)]['Age-adjusted Rate'].iloc[0]
result = 'Alabama' if alabama_rate > alaska_rate else 'Alaska'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
sub = df[(df['State'] == 'Alaska') & (df['Year'] >= 2008) & (df['Year'] <= 2016)]
max_year = sub.loc[sub['Crude Death Rate'].idxmax(), 'Year']
